purpose: Teach: 上方/封印/軌跡/骨格/懐疑/名門/先入観/取り除く

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、論文、江戸の上方文化、丁寧に、扱っていますね、本当に、視点、独創的でした。
lines.en: Ren, the way you handled Edo kamigata culture in your paper—your perspective was genuinely original.
lines.style: Warm and genuinely impressed. Measured pace with slight emphasis on 「独創的」. Lean forward slightly. The tone of a teacher who is speaking to a student she respects.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。戦時下、封印された言論、戦後、再評価されてきた歴史、扱いました、貴重な視点で。
lines.en: Thank you. I focused on how wartime discourse was suppressed and then reassessed after the war—trying to understand that history from a critical angle.
lines.style: Quiet intensity. Careful articulation of each idea, as though placing blocks deliberately. Slight nervous pause before explaining the scope. Respectful but engaged.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 歴史家の軌跡、追体験するような、読み応え、ありますね、論文の中で、特に、感動的でした。
lines.en: You really do make the reader feel like they're walking through a historian's footsteps. That sense of discovery comes through in every section—it's moving.
lines.style: Thoughtful, unhurried. Genuine warmth without flattery. Slight pause after 「読み応え」, as if remembering a particular passage. Soft cadence.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。江戸時代の社会の骨格、論文で、明確に、示しました、新しい視点で、論じました。
lines.en: Thank you. I wanted to show the structural backbone of Edo society clearly, and then discuss it through that new lens.
lines.style: Measured and deliberate. Small breath between ideas. Pride in the work without self-promotion. Eyes steady but humble.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 戦後の歴史記述、懐疑的に、扱う視点、研究者として、必要ですね、桜さんも、見習って欲しいです。
lines.en: That critical stance toward post-war historical narratives—it's essential work for a researcher. I wish Sakura would develop that same skepticism.
lines.style: Thoughtful shift into broader observation. Slight edge of gentle challenge when mentioning Sakura. Not harsh, but purposeful. Teacher-voice, not colleague-voice.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。名門の家系、歴史の動かす力、ありましたね、論文で、丁寧に、扱いました、深い研究、できました。
lines.en: Thank you. These prestigious families did shape the course of history, and I wanted to examine that relationship carefully—to get deeper into what actually happened.
lines.style: Quiet conviction. Deliberate pacing. Small pause after acknowledging the families' role, as if honoring the weight of that history. Sincere without being grand.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 先入観なしに、歴史を、読み解く姿勢、本当に、立派です、これからも、続けて欲しいです、研究者として。
lines.en: That's what makes your work stand out—you read history without preconceptions. That kind of intellectual honesty is truly admirable. I hope you keep approaching your research this way.
lines.style: Final affirmation. Slower pace, slightly more formal register. Warm but serious. Emphasis on 「立派」. The sound of a teacher offering a genuine compliment and encouragement for the future.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。史料から、創作部分を、取り除く分析、論文の核心でした、新しい解釈、できたと思っております。
lines.en: Thank you. The core of my paper was learning to separate archival fact from later reinterpretation, and I think that opened up new ways of understanding the material.
lines.style: Reflective and precise. Slight vocal lift on 「できたと思っております」—careful, slightly formal gratitude. Calm certainty. The tone of someone who has done the work and knows what they found.
